component.name: DSAlyrik
component.summary: Word-by-word lyrics for the music playing on your desktop

description.p: DSAlyrik follows any MPRIS media player and shows its lyrics on a transparent, click-through overlay, highlighting each word as it is sung.

ul.li: Four styles: Drift, Lens, Lens + Glyphs and Glyphs
Colors can follow the album art
Can keep the display awake while music plays
Lyrics come from LRCLIB and are never written to disk
